[[File:1801.png|right]] 18.01 '''Region:''' [[The Grey Mountains]] Connects to: 17.03 and 17.05. ==The Lair of the Ostrlich==

The site of the Last Skirmish ([[17.03]]) is known by all to be accursed and haunted by the ghosts of men, [[halflings]] and [[ostriches]]. Yet fewer men are aware of the most terrible undead ostrich of all - the immortal [[ostrlich]] who dwells here in an empty barrow, to the north of the battlefield.

See [[ostrlich]] for more, including details of the barrow.
